tour.name: Cappadocia Green Tour: Derinkuyu Underground City, Ihlara Valley & Selime
tour.subtitle: A private day in southern Cappadocia with a licensed guide: descend into the Byzantine underground city of Derinkuyu, walk along the river in the green canyon of Ihlara past painted rock churches, lunch by the water in Belisırma, and climb into Selime, the largest rock-cut monastery in the region.

tour.overview:
Southern Cappadocia hides two very different worlds: one deep underground, the other in a green canyon. This private day, known locally as the Green Tour, shows you both with a licensed guide and private car.

You begin at Derinkuyu, the deepest of the underground cities open to visitors. Over many centuries, and above all in the Byzantine period, its people dug down level after level into the soft rock, creating a refuge of living rooms, kitchens, stables, wine presses, wells and chapels linked by narrow tunnels, with ventilation shafts and great round stone doors that could be rolled shut from the inside. In times of danger thousands of people and their animals could hide here for weeks. Back in the daylight you drive south to the Ihlara Valley, a canyon about 14 kilometres long cut by the Melendiz river, where monks carved churches into the cliffs and painted them with saints. You walk about four kilometres along the river under poplars and willows, visiting a painted church on the way, and have lunch at a riverside restaurant in Belisırma. You end at Selime, a monastery complex carved into the rock cones at the mouth of the valley, with a cathedral-like church, kitchens and stables.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 8 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in Göreme, Uçhisar, Ürgüp, Avanos or Ortahisar
• Type: private tour with licensed guide, car and driver
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: moderate; about 4 km of easy walking in Ihlara, plus stairs and low tunnels at Derinkuyu

WHAT YOU SEE
• Derinkuyu underground city.
• The Ihlara Valley and the Ağaçaltı (Daniel) Church.
• Belisırma village.
• Selime Monastery.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private car means you are in the underground city before the coach groups, walk Ihlara at your own pace, and are collected at the end of the walk rather than having to retrace your steps.

WHO IT SUITS
Active travellers, families with older children, history lovers and anyone who has already done the Red Tour.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
If you are claustrophobic or prefer less walking, our Red Tour stays above ground in the valleys around Göreme.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The tunnels at Derinkuyu are narrow and low, with steep steps; it is cool underground all year. Wear good walking shoes and bring a light jacket. The drive from Göreme to Ihlara takes about 1 hour 15 minutes.

days.name: Derinkuyu, the Ihlara Valley, Belisırma and Selime
days.description:
What to expect: a private day in southern Cappadocia with a licensed guide, private car, tickets and a riverside lunch.

Your guide and driver collect you at about 8:45 and drive about 40 minutes south to Derinkuyu, arriving as it opens. From a modest entrance in the town, passages lead down level after level into the rock, to a depth of about 85 metres, of which several levels are open to visitors. Your guide shows you how the city worked: stables near the top for the animals, living and sleeping rooms, kitchens blackened by smoke, a wine press, a chapel and a missionary school, wells and a deep ventilation shaft that kept the air fresh. At key points, round stone doors weighing hundreds of kilograms could be rolled across the passages from inside. The origins of these cities go back to antiquity, but they were greatly enlarged in the Byzantine centuries, when the region's Christian communities sheltered here from raids.

You then drive about 1 hour to the Ihlara Valley. From the stairs near the village of Ihlara you descend into the canyon, up to about 100 metres deep, and walk downstream along the Melendiz river among poplars, willows and birdsong. On the way your guide takes you into one of the many rock-cut churches, such as the Ağaçaltı Church with its frescoes of Daniel in the lions' den and the Ascension. After about 4 kilometres you reach Belisırma, where lunch is served at a restaurant with tables on platforms right above the river, often with fresh trout. Your driver meets you there.

In the afternoon you visit Selime Monastery, carved into a cluster of rock cones at the northern end of the valley. You climb through its kitchen with a huge chimney, stables, living quarters and a church with a high vaulted nave and columns cut from the rock, with views over the valley mouth. On the way back you stop at a viewpoint over Pigeon Valley, and you are at your hotel at about 17:00.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:45 – Pick-up from your hotel.
09:30 – Derinkuyu underground city (about 1 hour 15 minutes).
11:00 – Drive to the Ihlara Valley.
12:00 – Ihlara Valley walk with a rock church (about 1 hour 30 minutes, 4 km).
13:30 – Riverside lunch in Belisırma.
14:45 – Selime Monastery (about 1 hour).
16:00 – Drive back with a stop at Pigeon Valley.
17:00 – Return to your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The tunnels at Derinkuyu are narrow and low; people who are claustrophobic can visit only the upper levels or skip it, and we can replace it with Kaymaklı underground city, which is shallower.
• The Ihlara walk is mostly flat, on an earth path, with some 360 steps down into the canyon at the start.
• In winter the valley path can be icy; we shorten the walk if needed.

INCLUDED: private car and driver, licensed guide, tickets to Derinkuyu, the Ihlara Valley and Selime Monastery, lunch, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks at lunch, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: What is the Green Tour?
faq.answer: It is the local name for the classic day tour of southern Cappadocia: an underground city, the Ihlara Valley and Selime. The Red Tour covers Göreme and the northern valleys.

faq.question: Is Derinkuyu suitable for claustrophobic people?
faq.answer: The tunnels are narrow and low in places. You can visit only the upper levels, or we can visit Kaymaklı underground city instead, which is shallower and more spacious.

faq.question: How long is the walk in Ihlara?
faq.answer: About 4 km, mostly flat along the river, taking about 1.5 hours with stops. There are about 360 steps down into the canyon at the start.

faq.question: Can we walk more or less?
faq.answer: Yes. Your driver can collect you at different points, so we can shorten the walk or extend it towards Selime for keen hikers.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: Yes, at a riverside restaurant in Belisırma, often with fresh trout. Vegetarian dishes are always available.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes, for children who can walk a few kilometres. Children usually love the tunnels and stone doors of the underground city.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: It is not ideal, as there are steep steps underground and into the canyon. Tell us and we will suggest an easier itinerary.

faq.question: Can we take photos underground?
faq.answer: Yes, photography is allowed in the underground city and Selime. Inside some painted churches it may be restricted.

faq.question: Will we be taken to shops?
faq.answer: No. There are no shopping stops on this tour unless you ask for one.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Good walking shoes, a light jacket for the underground city, which is cool all year, and a hat and sunscreen for the canyon in summer.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: Spring and autumn are perfect for walking. Summer is warm but shady in the canyon; in winter the path can be icy.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
